title: Introduction to Data Science in Economics and Business 1

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to clean and prepare data for analysis.
Proficiency in creating visual representations of data using tools like ggplot2.
Ability to build statistical models including linear regression, spline regression, and generalized additive models.
Understanding and application of supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques.
Proficiency in using R for data science tasks including data manipulation and model building.
